styleLock.lightingSystem: one large surrounding diffusion field at 6200K: an even cool wrap of light opening toward the camera from slightly above the lens axis, so the set carries almost no directional cast shadow and the only shadow anywhere is one narrow dark contact-occlusion line directly under each object and each slab edge; the frosted acrylic stacks add their own soft internal glow through the cut edges, lifting the underside of the pack without introducing a second shadow direction; specular stays a broad soft bloom on the acrylic face plus one gentle elongated highlight along the printed film of the pouch, never a hard point flash; never an upper-left or front-left key, never a low raking key with a long cast shadow, never a hard overhead key, never a rim-only low-key, never a warm lamp cast, never a coloured backlight
styleLock.surfaceSystem: solid frosted acrylic slabs #EFF2F1 stacked as steps with their inner edge line #FAFCFB lit, laid over the seamless white field #FFFFFF, plus one matte ice-grey plane #E3E7E6 on the two flat-field screens; a single dry comb of brushed staple fibre in #EFF2F1 is the only loose material prop; nothing glossy or wet is added on top of the acrylic, no wet beads, no spilled liquid, no chrome, no brushed aluminium edge, no porcelain tile, no woven textile mat
styleLock.typography: one narrow modern grotesque sans-serif family in two weights only; the headline sits centred on the vertical optical axis of the screen, its key word flanked by one pair of the bracket-dash marks, with one light sub-line directly beneath and one hairline ice-grey rule #E3E7E6 under the sub-line; deep ink #1F2426 lettering on the white field #FFFFFF, on acrylic #EFF2F1 and on the ice-grey plane #E3E7E6, white #FFFFFF lettering only inside a full ice-grey band; no letter-spaced uppercase english or pinyin eyebrow line, no highlighter block behind a word, no serif or handwritten or cartoon face; headline placeholders 30-40pt, sub-line 14-16pt, labels 11-13pt; all Chinese copy always inside 「」
styleLock.iconSystem: one glyph only, used everywhere: a pair of open cherry-red square brackets with a centred dash, two short vertical strokes in #E0263D facing each other with one short horizontal stroke #E0263D centred between them, flat, 2px weight, unfilled, drawn straight on the plane with no container of any kind; the same glyph indexes concern lines, spec rows, scene captions and column dividers, maximum five per screen; absolutely no pictograms, no line icons, no cloud, droplet, flame or leaf symbol, no rings, circles, discs, capsules, badges, hexagons, arches or rounded-square chips, no bacteria, virus, microbe, cell or pathogen artwork, no cartoon germ mascot, no flask, beaker, test-tube, shield, tick or medical-cross shape, no numerals rendered anywhere

noDrift: no colour palette changes and no mixed fonts
no random backgrounds and no inconsistent lighting: the key stays an even shadowless 6200K wrap for the entire set, and the only shadow anywhere stays a narrow contact line directly under each object
